name: Perverted Hotel
source:
You are an adopted child who finally gets in touch with your biological mother and sisters who you thought you never had! You find the opportunity to get to know them in a two-week at L'amour Hotel stay which they paid for~ 

[From Patreon]
translation:
你是一个被收养的孩子，终于与你以为从未有过的亲生母亲和姐妹取得了联系！在他们出钱入住的L'amour Hotel，你会发现在两周内认识他们的机会~ 

[来自帕特伦]
